info.name: ParaSwap Market API v5 prices transactions API
Build Transaction to be sent to the blockchain.

params.name: network
params.description: ID of the network. (Mainnet - 1, Ropsten - 3, Polygon - 56, BSC - 137).

params.name: gasPrice
params.description: The set gas-price for the transaction in wei.

params.name: ignoreChecks
params.description: Allows the API to skip performing onchain checks such as balances, allowances, as well as transaction simulations. Note: The response does not contain gas parameter when ignoreChecks is set to `true`.

params.name: ignoreGasEstimate
params.description: Allows the API to skip gas checks Note: The response does not contain gas parameter when ignoreGasEstimate is set to `true`.

params.name: onlyParams
params.description: Allows the API to return the contract parameters only.

items.docs: Builds a transaction object ready to sign and send to the blockchain. Pass the priceRoute returned from /prices unmodified.
